title: The Trees Will Clap Their Hands
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Oh, seek the Lord while He is near,
And call Him when you're small;
His thoughts are higher than the sky,
The highest sky of all.

[Chorus]
Go out with joy, go out with joy,
The hills will start to sing;
And all the trees will clap their hands
For every growing thing.

[Verse 2]
The rain comes down, the snow comes down,
And never turns around;
It waters every little seed
Till bread comes from the ground.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
And so His word comes down like rain,
And this is what I know:
It never once comes back to Him
Till something good will grow.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So look and see, and seek and find,
Like Scout who found his boot;
The Lord has planted joy in you,
And joy will bear its fruit.

[Chorus]
mood: Skipping music. A light, bouncing step under the voice, the stomp of a child in two found boots going down a hallway and breaking into song. Soft ukulele strum keeping the skip, an upright bass walking underneath, a small lift where the trees clap. It brightens a little with every verse, and the last chorus is the gladdest of all, still gentle, never loud.
